lead: Two-plus years in space planning, concept development, and 3D visualisation — from the first client brief through drawings, site visits, and handover.

roles.title: Interior Designer
highlights: Consult with prospective clients during Experience Center visits to understand design requirements, space constraints, and aesthetic preferences.
Review and explain design quotations and scope of work so layouts and materials stay aligned with the brief.
Coordinate with sales and execution teams to keep client-facing details — layout, materials, timelines — accurate.
Conduct site visits to assess feasibility and support a smooth handoff from concept to execution.

roles.title: Interior Designer
highlights: Advised clients on space planning, layout, and material selection, turning requirements into functional, aesthetically driven concepts.
Prepared and presented design concepts and 3D visualisations to support decisions at key project stages.
Coordinated with vendors and internal teams to keep timelines, budgets, and client expectations aligned.
Managed a portfolio of six design projects at once, from first consultation through final handover.

roles.title: Interior Design Intern
highlights: Started by assisting senior designers with 2D construction drawings across ongoing projects.
Progressed to leading 2D and 3D design work for a multi-design project, from concept through detailing.
Visited project sites for on-ground coordination between design and execution teams.

roles.title: Freelance Interior Projects
highlights: Contributed to residential interior and exterior design projects while completing coursework, handling concept development and rendering deliverables.

academic.title: Design Interventions for Public Spaces
academic.summary: Interdisciplinary project on functional, community-oriented public space design.
